I'm a data analyst with an engineering background. I turn complex data into
clear insights that help people make better decisions. I work with Python, SQL
and business intelligence tools to clean, analyze and visualize data, and to
build dashboards and models that answer real business questions.

My special interests sit where data meets the physical world: **engineering,
energy and climate**. I enjoy using analytics and machine learning to
understand performance, risk and change over time, and to communicate the
findings in a way any audience can act on.
